name: KAISER 4 GT3

specs.notes: BMW M Motorsport's M4 GT3 (2022 on): the 3.0 P58 twin-turbo straight six, up to 590 hp subject to balance of performance, a straight-cut six-speed Xtrac sequential transaxle (from the M8 GTE's), a 2,917 mm wheelbase (BMW's press data; 2,901 mm for the M6 GT3 before it). Race weight given as 1,285-1,339 kg depending on the source and the rules; 1,300 kg here. Run to the APEX GT CHALLENGE's balance of performance (laps CINDER RIDGE within a few tenths of the AFFALTER GT3 on the AI's line: tests/race_ai_check.gd); its torque curve, aero and ratios are estimates.

garage.blurb: A big-kidneyed GT3 with a twin-turbo straight six and a long wheelbase: planted in fast corners, brutal on the brakes, and it needs a patient right foot out of hairpins.

interior.notes: The model's race cockpit (cage, carbon dash, bucket seat, the wheel with its screen): its wheel cut out by material inside a box (tools/cars/m4_gt3.json), the eye set by hand (the seat probe hit the headrest's wings); paddles: the hands stay on the wheel.
